remarks:
Your Hunting Camp Awaits in Friendship, NY!
Looking for a hunting base camp or weekend getaway? This 1.25-acre property features two adjoining parcels sold together in Friendship, Allegany County, New York, directly across Pigtail Road from approximately 3,500 acres of state forest known for deer, bear, and small-game hunting.
The mostly wooded property features an existing single-wide trailer on the 0.4-acre parcel, a gravel driveway, electricity, and a small creek reported to run through the land. The trailer has been on-site for over 20 years and has been used as a hunting camp. It sits on jacks and blocks and features a metal roof installed over the original roof, with no leaks reported by the seller. The living room and kitchen have seen the most use, and the seller estimates its condition at 6.5-7 out of 10.
With mowed grassy areas and a rural setting, this property offers a starting point for seasonal hunting trips, camping, and outdoor escapes. Enjoy access to extensive public forest, nearby local services, and Interstate 86 for regional travel.
Ready for your next outdoor adventure? This property might be for you.
